Contact & support

Talk to the team.

Get in touch

For game support, feedback, bugs, privacy requests or content reports, email room310support@gmail.com. This is the public support contact for Room310 × OneShotStudios and PolyGolf on polygolf.lol.

Report a bug

Tell us what happened, which course and hole you were playing, your browser and device, and the steps that caused the problem. A screenshot can help. Do not send passwords, sign-in tokens or payment information.

Account and privacy requests

Include your username and explain whether you need help with access, profile correction, a data copy or account deletion. We may ask you to verify ownership before changing or releasing account data. Username-only accounts may be difficult to recover if credentials are lost.

Community and copyright reports

Include the map name, username or URL involved and explain the issue. For copyright reports, identify the work you own and your authority to report it. Please avoid sharing unnecessary personal information about other players.

Purchases

Real-money purchases are not available. “Coming Soon” buttons do not take payment. Country Club membership and lockers can currently be obtained using eligible in-game coins and rewards.

Thanks for playing

Every round, bug report, shared map and word of encouragement helps us build a better game. Thank you for supporting our small development team.
